# Physics KetBra original references

The active `PhysicsMethods.KetBra` handler for `\outerproduct`, `\dyad`, `\ketbra` and `\op` reads a second argument only when the next nonspace source character is `{`. The original `GetNext` commits JavaScript whitespace even when no argument follows; the remaining operator, script, control sequence or closing token stays with its caller. An absent bra repeats the ket, while an explicitly empty `{}` remains empty. Exactly one star is consumed; a second star is an argument token.

Both existing source expansion strings, including `\!` and semantic braces, are unchanged. One fresh child parses the complete expansion with the copied caller font/identifier environment, shared registrations and a fresh macro counter. Both operands share that child counter. Local `parseChild` plus `unwrapInferred` preserves this contract without changing the generic expansion helper, other handlers, command priority or final-item delivery.

## Public fixture and source failures

`physics_ketbra_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` retains 1,796 distinct TeX/display inputs and every complete original response:

- 1,764 complete, unmodified SVG assertions: 1,676 valid renderings and 88 error renderings.
- 32 original NEL runtime failures, separately asserted as the bounded API error `no Unicode range for character U+0085` with empty SVG. Each original has literal NEL input and retains its full exception beginning `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading '4')`.

The candidate has 390 SVG fixes, 1,374 unchanged SVG controls and zero SVG regressions or changed source-SVG residuals. Of the 32 runtime cases, 16 replace prior incorrect rendered successes and 16 retain an existing bounded error. These 16 changed runtime outcomes are counted separately, not as exact SVG fixes or original exception-message parity. There is no omitted raw partition.

The capture reuses 480 earlier complete originals, including all 24 held GetStar KetBra raw controls, and adds 1,316 captures. The latter include 18 distinct literal expansions. All 72 target-to-literal bindings (24 held cases plus 48 font cases) compare complete original SVGs; these inputs already belong to the same 1,796 inventory.

## Source observations and budgets

`physics_ketbra_font_observations.json.gz` preserves 48 passive records: four aliases, three star states, two MathFont contexts and two display modes. Each generated child enters at cursor and macro count zero with the copied font, multi-letter identifier pattern and `noAutoOP`. Every observed output equals its uninstrumented full original.

`physics_ketbra_budget_observations.json.gz` preserves 16 passive parser-entry/return records within the main public inventory. Outer 999/1000 substitutions still enter a fresh child at zero. An absent bra duplicates the ket in that single child: 499 and 500 operand expansions render at totals 998 and 1000, while 501 produces the original maximum-substitution error at 1002. Distinct operands share the same counter; observed totals 998, 999 and 1000 render. The main public fixture also retains the corresponding complete-original budget controls across aliases and modes.

The 48 font and 16 budget inputs are 64 distinct existing public inputs. They add no public cases or duplicate SVG assertion count. The passive observer calls each original method once and does not modify the returned tree. Independent recapture reproduced all complete outputs and event objects exactly.

## Original-only regeneration

The original is MathJax commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`; the three pinned D2 asset hashes are included in the fixture.

```sh
node --jitless testdata/generate_physics_ketbra.cjs /absolute/path/to/oracle-assets /absolute/path/to/scratch-output
```

Use a separate scratch output directory. No Go process supplies an expectation. The generator verifies every full original SVG, preserves historical complete runtime exception objects, and saves fresh full runtime exceptions while checking the same null-range first line and literal NEL input. JSONL transport escapes line/paragraph separators. It independently repeats all 64 passive records and requires the complete observation objects and uninstrumented outputs to agree.

All three gzip fixtures regenerated byte-identically. The inventory binds their hashes and the complete regeneration receipt. The public Go test asserts unique names/input pairs, the original source pin, complete SVG strings and the exact bounded-error contract; it does not normalize SVGs or derive golden values from Go.
